He is widely considered as one of the greatest players of all time, being named the best player of 2019, 2020, 2023 and 2025, and a runner-up for the best player of 2021 and 2022. In addition, he has won a record 34 [[HLTV/MVP Awards|HLTV MVP]] awards, three [[Majors|Major]] championships, including a record three Major MVP awards, and two [[ESL/Grand Slam|ESL Grand Slams]].
